mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_logs(order_id, operator_id, operator_name, action, remark) VALUES(#{orderId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{action}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, operator_id AS operatorId, operator_name AS operatorName, action, remark, created_at AS createdAt FROM order_logs WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
